purpose: Determine whether learned task-scoped experience earns its total cost compared with no memory and a bounded factual-memory baseline.

training.selection: All valid receipts, including failures; no resampling to obtain desired examples

development.purpose: Select a useful mechanism before audit. Every rejected round remains in the resource ledger.

audit.split_scope: Held-out operator formulas and sizes within pointwise/reduction families, not unseen families

common_controls.trial_order: Balanced permutation by task and repeat frozen before submissions
common_controls.invalid_or_timeout_attempts: Count as failed attempts with full observed cost, never silently replace

primary_criteria.correctness: No wrong final kernel; fallback and no-result outcomes distinguished
primary_criteria.quality: Per-task protection and no overall quality reduction; same frozen evaluator gate
primary_criteria.cost: All-attempt solver, independent full evaluation and model tokens retained; include learning and development selection cost for RSI
primary_criteria.minimum_practical_effect: At least 10% lower all-in cost at protected quality, or at least 10% higher paired quality at no more than 5% additional all-in cost
primary_criteria.uncertainty: Paired task-cluster bootstrap 95% interval for primary outcome; repeat trajectories are not independent task samples
primary_criteria.comparison: Must beat control and raw-memory on the predeclared primary criterion; otherwise complex RSI is not justified

additional_reports: Time to first promotable candidate, failures treated as not reached
Cause-classified repeated errors with source/condition bindings
GPU allocation seconds and known/unknown API usage
Break-even task count with explicit deployment horizon; no hypothetical amortization claimed as observed gain
stop_rules: Stop development after two candidate rounds if neither passes practical gates; do not spend audit GPU to search for a positive result
Final audit is never fed back into selection and rerun as independent evidence
Any resource exhaustion exports partial results and terminates; no blind retry
No candidate may modify evaluator, thresholds, permissions, budgets or protected files
limitations: Not a reproduction of ACE/GEPA/DGM and cannot establish superiority over those algorithms
GPU wall time, model tokens and money are separate units; no unsupported conversion
A single hardware/model configuration does not establish production or cross-device generality
